headline: Nigeria’s Single-Digit Inflation Target Puts Focus on Lending Rates
summary: The Nigerian government's target to bring inflation below 10 percent has put borrowing costs in the spotlight as monetary authorities manage lending rates.
why: Central bank inflation targets dictate benchmark interest rate trajectories, directly influencing corporate borrowing costs, bond yields, and commercial bank margins.

impacts.name: Banking and Finance
impacts.why: Government disinflation goals and shifting lending rates directly impact commercial loan demand and bank net interest margins.
